notes: Reconciliation: τοῖς κλητοῖς is a substantival article with an adjective complement, not a participle, so no verb carries the supplied relativizer. Moved “that” onto the article — τοῖς → “to them that”, κλητοῖς → “are called” — matching rule 31's reasoning and the corpus, where every chapter of this shape (JHN.8.7, JHN.11.37, JHN.18.16, JHN.8.29, JHN.2.10, 3JN.1.11, REV.3.7) keeps the relativizer on the article and gives the adjective only the copula under rule 53.
